scope: Manual actual installed-wiring STEP/manifest binding to the current source electrical graph and native wiring bodies, including their placements inside the complete appliance STEP. No equipment/contact sweep or mechanical regeneration. Unchanged accepted contact receipts remain separately scoped.

retained_termination_source_reuse.scope: Retained termination construction statements compared with the pre-direct-J13 source. Removed pogo construction is not included in the retained fourteen bodies.

native_source_cache.scope: Reuse unchanged native source solids only after matching current source curves, termination records and jacket geometry. All actual STEP wiring bodies are read back in this command.

exchange_scope: Native source solids and geometric agreement are distinct from STEP reader orientation validity. Any listed readback-invalid bodies retain their explicit exchange limitation; no per-wire geometry is altered to silence it.

metadata_rebindings.scope: Metadata-only physical-artifact rebind. The standalone wiring STEP and CSV are byte-identical; every manifest section except physical-scene provenance and source hashes is semantically identical. The only changed hashed source defines the B-fill printed link cutter. Native source/body signatures, curve comparisons, installed-wire placement readings and ten exchange-validity flags are reused; no STEP readback, source-curve reconstruction, contact or packing query is repeated.

installed_readback_scope: Signatures were measured at native_query_artifacts. The current appliance reference reuses them through the explicit byte-identical wiring/unchanged placement metadata proof in metadata_rebindings; no new physical-STEP readback is asserted.
